basic_info.description: Rare, completely detached & tastefully renovated 3 bed 2 bath Noe Valley View Home.  On a huge landscaped lot this light filled home is close to all transit & restaurants.  The excellent floor plan includes 17" cathedral ceilings, wood burning fireplace, views form every room, two decks, a private master suite, large gourmet kitchen with french doors opening to a sunny south facing patio.  With fresh interior paint, tons of close space & newly remodeled laundry room this home is ready to move in.
